Replace.Text: Serbia - a civilization at the crossroads of empires, faith, and industry.

International and domestic Trade Routes yield +2 [ICON_Gold] Gold and +1 [ICON_Culture] Culture. Mines yield +1 [ICON_Production] Production and +1 [ICON_Faith] Faith. Ancient, Medieval, and Renaissance Walls each provide +1 [ICON_Culture] Culture.
Brotherhood, Unity and Five Year Plan

Industrial Zones grant +2 [ICON_Production] Production and +2 [ICON_Science] Science. Campuses grant +2 [ICON_Production] Production. Under Communism: +25% [ICON_Production] Production and +25% [ICON_Science] Science in all cities.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Unique Unit: Partizani (replaces Infantry).

+8 [ICON_Faith] Faith in every city. May purchase units, buildings, and districts with [ICON_Faith] Faith. Generate [ICON_Gold] Gold equal to your total [ICON_Faith] Faith output.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Unique Unit: Chetnik (replaces Musketman).
+2 [ICON_Culture] Culture and +10 Loyalty in all cities. War Weariness reduced by 50%. All units gain +10 Combat Strength.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Unique Unit: Neva-M (replaces Artillery).
All cities generate +2 [ICON_Culture] Culture and +2 Loyalty per turn.[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Unique Unit: Almanska Garda (replaces Knight).
Zivelo bratstvo i jedinstvo nasih naroda!
Za kralja i otadzbinu, sa verom u Boga!
Niko ne sme da vas bije!
Carstvo Nebesko i zemaljsko - zakonom i maceem.

From the first stirring of life beneath the water, to the great beasts of the Stone Age, to man taking his first upright steps — you have come far. Now, Josip Broz Tito, forge brotherhood and unity across the mountains and valleys of Serbia, and lead your people through the storms of the industrial age.

From the first stirring of life beneath the water, to the great beasts of the Stone Age, to man taking his first upright steps — you have come far. Draza Mihailovic, the Mountain Fox, rise from the highlands: keep the faith, defend the homeland, and never yield the hills.

From the first stirring of life beneath the water, to the great beasts of the Stone Age, to man taking his first upright steps — you have come far. Slobodan Milosevic, rally the people, harden their resolve, and let no one break the will of Serbia.

From the first stirring of life beneath the water, to the great beasts of the Stone Age, to man taking his first upright steps — you have come far. Stefan Dusan, Emperor of the Serbs, write your Code in law and steel, and raise an empire worthy of heaven and earth.
